String expectedFormat = "superfakeformat";
String actualFormat = null;

try {
    net.coobird.thumbnailator.Thumbnails.of(sourceImage)
        .size(10, 10)
        .outputFormat(expectedFormat)
        .toOutputStream(imageBytes);
    assert false : "Expected UnsupportedFormatException to be thrown";
} catch (net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.UnsupportedFormatException e) {
    actualFormat = e.getFormatName();
} catch (java.io.IOException e) {
    assert false : "Expected UnsupportedFormatException, but got standard IOException: " + e.getMessage();
}

assert expectedFormat.equals(actualFormat) : "Format name should match the unsupported format requested";
System.out.println("__CHECK__ getFormatName " + actualFormat);
